user.title: Nook
user.description: Choose the boiler/heater switch and the house temperature sensor. Add rooms and wall panels from the Nook sidebar after setup.

import_old.title: Import from Neat Thermostat
import_old.description: Neat Thermostat (this integration's old name) is installed. Nook will copy its settings, move its heating entities to Nook's names (their history comes too) and, once you remove Neat Thermostat, take over with its learned data. Nook won't control the heating until then.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Nook instance is allowed.

init.title: Nook options
init.description: Prefer the Nook sidebar for rooms, schedule, and wall panels. Use this form for quick tweaks or to add one room.
